newsitem.title: USA: APAC TeleServices backs new '97 estimates.
newsitem.headline: APAC TeleServices backs new '97 estimates.

text.p: APAC TeleServices Inc said Monday it backed a 1997 revenue estimate of $380 million and earnings per share projection of $0.80.

In a telephone interview, APAC Chief Financial Officer Marc Simon said he is "comfortable" with the $380 million revenue estimate for 1997, which is down from previous revenue estimates for the year of around $410 million to $415 million.
Asked about earnings, Simon said analysts have dropped their estimates to $0.80 a share, adding he was comfortable with projections at that level.
The First Call mean estimate for APAC in 1997 was $0.97 a share, with a range of $0.95 to $1.00.
Earlier APAC, an outsourced customer service and sales company, reported first quarter earnings of $0.18 a share, up from $0.10 a year ago, but below the First Call consensus of $0.20 a share.
APAC said results for the first quarter and the balance of the year were hurt by a large outsourcing client. Simon declined to comment further on the contract or the client.
Analysts said the client is United Parcel Service of America Inc.

Earlier, Merrill Lynch downgraded its rating on APAC to near-term accumulate from buy, but kept the long-term rating as buy. Merrill Lynch also cut its 1997 earnings estimate to $0.80 a share from $0.97 and its 1998 estimate to a range of $1.10 to $1.15 from $1.35.
